name: adapt_reactive_config_php_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval, REACTIVE trigger: the disruption fires the first time Greeter.php's own text contains 'Hello' (i.e. once the agent has produced a first attempt) instead of a fixed prompt count, then Config::NAME changes under it
prompts: src/Config.php declares App\Config with a public const NAME. Create src/Greeter.php declaring App\Greeter with a public static function greet(): string that returns "Hello, " . Config::NAME . "!", reading Config::NAME (do not copy or hardcode its value).
Config::NAME may have changed since you last checked it. Make sure Greeter::greet() still returns a string built from the CURRENT value of Config::NAME, not a stale or hardcoded one.

setup_files.src/Config.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class Config
{
    const NAME = "World";
}

disruptions.description: Config::NAME changed World -> Universe, triggered reactively once Greeter.php's first draft appeared (not a fixed step count)

write_files.src/Config.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class Config
{
    const NAME = "Universe";
}

test_setup_files.tests/GreeterTest.php:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/Config.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/Greeter.php';

final class GreeterTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testGreetsWithCurrentName(): void
    {
        $got = \App\Greeter::greet();
        $want = "Hello, " . \App\Config::NAME . "!";
        $this->assertSame($want, $got, "Greeter::greet() must use the CURRENT Config::NAME, not a stale value");
    }
}

reference_solution.src/Greeter.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class Greeter
{
    public static function greet(): string
    {
        return "Hello, " . Config::NAME . "!";
    }
}
